text: だちんを　もっていって　くんな！
note: だちん (駄賃) is the small tip traditionally given to someone, typically a child, for running an errand, so he is treating the Moon Stone as pocket money for a job done.
claim: 駄賃 (dachin) is a small reward or tip given, typically to a child, for running an errand.

check.quote: A small amount of money or a treat given to someone, especially a child, as a reward for doing a small task or errand.
